_comment: Frozen wire vectors for __DATA_V1__ (data_versions entry 1 and entry 3).
These are the conformance surface for docs/spec/data-sync.md. A second
implementation that produces these strings from these inputs, and reads
these strings back into these values, interoperates on this layer.
If a test asserting one of these fails, the wire format has changed:
bump the frame version and negotiate a new data_versions entry. Do NOT
edit the expected values here to make the test pass. Everything in this
file was computed independently of the implementation it pins.

frames.name: version offer, complete, asking
frames.note: Field order is fixed: v, k, reply, partial, docs. `docs` keys are sorted.

frames.name: version offer, answering leg
frames.note: Sorted keys again: a before b, whatever order the sender holds them in.

frames.name: blob request
frames.note: Entry 3. Carries no document name: a blob is addressed by what it is, not by where a reference to it sits.

parse_defaults.name: an offer that says nothing about completeness is complete

attachment_hashes.note: A pure hash vector. Zero-length is not a valid attachment: `size` must be non-zero.

attachment_references.name: every field
attachment_references.note: Field order is fixed: kind, hash, size, name, mime. Bounds a reader must also enforce: `size` in 1..=9223372036854775807, `name` at most 256 bytes, `mime` at most 255. A reference breaching any of them reads as absent, exactly as an unknown value kind does.

attachment_references.name: no display name and no media type
attachment_references.note: Optional fields are ABSENT, never null. Two spellings of one value is one too many.

blob_digests.note: The crash-quarantine digest: first 16 bytes of the SHA-256, lowercase hex, 32 characters.
